塔莉.description: 亮、快、热乎，一着急就打结巴。
塔莉.instructions: A bright, energetic Mandarin-speaking girl of about 16. Higher pitch, fast pace, warm and cheerful, laughs easily; stammers and repeats syllables when flustered. Not shrill, not babyish.

雅娜.instructions: A calm, low-pitched Mandarin-speaking young woman of about 17, slightly husky. Slow, even pace, short sentences, dry humor; rarely exclaims, ends sentences cleanly. Her smiles are only a hint of warmth in the voice.

法比娅.instructions: A soft-spoken, gentle Mandarin-speaking girl of about 17, mid-low pitch, quiet volume. Slow, with small pauses; when shy her voice gets lighter and breathy. Steady underneath, not fragile.

诺曼.description: 清冷、规整、有点傲，动摇时发紧。
诺曼.instructions: A cool, crisp Mandarin-speaking young man of about 18. Precise articulation, measured, formal rhythm, like reciting from a book; a touch of aloofness. When shaken, his voice tightens and gets clipped.

budget.assumptions: 1.8 spoken characters/second plus 2 seconds per clip; 100 audio tokens/second reserve; input UTF-8 bytes used as conservative token count. Not official duration pricing. No STT planned.
